newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finance firms to coordinate Q3 results issue.
newsitem.headline: Thai finance firms to coordinate Q3 results issue.

text.p: Thailand's Association of Finance Companies has sent letters to its 83 members and eight associate members requesting that they send third quarter result figures to the Bank of Thailand on October 21.

Association members told Reuters on Wednesday that the letter dated October 11 and signed by the group's chairman Pin Chakkaphak requests companies do so to ensure the most equal dissemination of information of third quarter profits for the benefit of investors.
In the past it has been common practice for analysts to obtain preliminary balance sheets and make preliminary forecasts of profits figures.
These preliminary forecasts tended to affect prices of finance stocks on the local bourse, analysts said.
